create_pocman_env: create a PocManEnv instance to run the micro maze POMDP environment with gym API
run_pocman_step: run a single step in the PocManEnv by calling step with an action integer 0-3
reset_pocman_env: reset the PocManEnv to initial state and get the first observation vector
create_ghost_agent: create a Ghost instance with position, direction, and ghost_range for maze navigation
compute_manhattan_distance: compute the Euclidean distance between two Position objects using manhattan_distance function
